verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Greenhouse keeps candidate profiles that can hold attachments such as resumes (greenhouse-docs-20), merges duplicate candidates into one record (greenhouse-docs-17), and keeps interview notes mapped to scorecard feedback inside the platform with "no data silos" (greenhouse-docs-21, greenhouse-docs-33). Nothing in the pack shows email threads, a per-candidate activity timeline, or consent status living on that same profile. Missing for 10: email threads on the candidate record, per-candidate activity history, consent/GDPR status on the profile, explicit documentation of a single unified candidate view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
